note: Draft register for Spec 052 (design D-01, arm A only, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign plan approved by the owner as written on 2026-10-21 (Part 2, member 1) and the portfolio triage of the same date, which found D-01 arm A RIPE. Conventions as in Specs 032-042: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-PHASE43-RECORD (the Phase-43 results file is the record of the in-lineage battery), ASM-PHASE121-RECORD (the Phase-121 dataset, memo and results are the record of the Soviet compilation as held), ASM-DESIGN-D01 (design D-01's criteria, method and limits govern substance), ASM-CROSSWALK-V1 (crosswalk v1 as pinned is the identity map of record), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (pins, provenance and the battery definition precede any outcome quantity), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen and settled records are never edited).
